method: Current Swift declarations read without build or runtime execution. OptionGroup membership expanded; wrapper metadata is parsed without help prose. No product changes.
count_rule: Each argument, option or flag property counts once; aliases/negative spellings do not add properties. Built-in help/version excluded from property counts. Optional flags remain nil/unset and inherit resolved settings.
